analyst_view.overall: Early view: This is Sarri's first game against Lazio since he left in June, now as Atalanta coach. Gattuso's Lazio were top and unbeaten before the break, though Nuno Tavares and Sutalo picked up muscle injuries at Napoli. Atalanta play this six days after Lecce and four days before a Conference League game at Riga, and their long injury list may have eased by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Lazio's home games average three goals and Atalanta's away games three, but Lazio concede little and Atalanta have struggled for goals away. I stay with the number.

corners.text: The site expects 9.4 corners. I lean slightly lower because Lazio's home games have averaged about 8.2 corners: Gattuso's side attack through quick wide players rather than crosses. Atalanta's away games have averaged about 9.4.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. Sarri's return adds some edge, and Lazio's games have averaged about 4.4 cards, but Atalanta's games are among the calmest in the league. I stay with the number until the referee is known.

shots.text: The site expects 27.3 shots. I lean slightly higher because Atalanta's away games have averaged 32 shots, with opponents taking more than 21 a game. Lazio pressed high at Napoli and should win the ball in dangerous areas against a side that has been fragile away.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. Lazio's home games have averaged about nine on target and Atalanta's away games about ten, so I stay with the number.
